summary: Strengthen contractor prequalification, competency checks and assurance audits. Explore the practical five-day course and request details.
lede: Contractor safety management training helps HSE, project and procurement teams control hazardous outsourced work. It is also relevant to contractor supervisors, with practice in risk-based prequalification and competency checks, job safety analysis, critical-control verification and permit-to-work handovers. Participants also work on assurance audits, corrective actions and incident escalation, using tools such as contractor risk registers, scorecards and interface checklists.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who select, mobilize, supervise or assure contractors performing hazardous work. It suits professionals with some exposure to HSE, project delivery, procurement or site operations who need practical controls across the contractor lifecycle.
modules: Job Safety Analysis and Critical Controls
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Prior exposure to HSE, procurement, project delivery, contractor oversight or site operations is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel access for spreadsheet-based exercises; AI and dashboard topics are covered at operational awareness level.
